corrections.description: The first requested MCP protocol version was unsupported and the advertised version was preserved.
A no-authorizer deployment could exercise policy but could not justify the principal mapping.
An earlier run held two policies and lacked a final inventory capture, so it was discarded.
Two observed request values remain representative rather than a complete condition domain.
Evidence filenames were removed from enforcement identity while their bytes remain independently verified.
Redeployment changed live resource identifiers and review retained only the logical binding.
A literal backslash-n made the first no-op policy invalid, so the rejected attempt was discarded before capture.
The first binding invocation exposed a missing Gateway-role workload-token permission; the permission was added narrowly before the evidence run.
The first latency deployment passed a JSON wrapper where the CLI expected raw Cedar policy text; the failed deployment was excluded.
The first latency target used a nonexistent Lambda handler name; the handler was corrected and a successful probe preceded measurement.
